title: Starter
description: Instagram: 1 post + 1 story set during competition windows; small logo on robot jersey back panel; small sleeve logo on team t-shirts for competitions.

title: Growth
description: Instagram: 3 posts + 4 story sets across the season (competitions + recap); medium logo on robot jersey back panel; medium sleeve logo on team t-shirts for competitions and media days.

title: Prime
description: Instagram: 6 posts + 8 story sets spread across the year (pre-season, competitions, mid-season highlights); prominent logo on robot chest/back; prominent logo on team t-shirts for competitions, media, and campus events.

title: Flagship
description: Instagram: 10 posts + 12 story sets year-round with pinned highlight; primary logo on robot chest for all events; primary logo on team t-shirts (front/back) for competitions, media, outreach, and year-round appearances.
